# CADeed.com — California Private Capital Engine

> A California private-capital engine for business-purpose, trust-deed-secured real estate loans. Describe a deal, calculate the numbers, and route it between borrowers, mortgage brokers, and private capital sources. Loan types include fix & flip, bridge, construction completion, cash-out refinance, and second deeds of trust.

CADeed.com is a private-lending platform run by Anatoliy Kanevsky, a licensed California mortgage and real estate broker in the Los Angeles area. It serves three sides of a private deal: borrowers seeking fast trust-deed financing, brokers placing business-purpose loans, and capital sources looking for deal flow. Loans are business-purpose and secured by California real estate.

- Focus: California, business-purpose (non-owner-occupied) trust-deed loans
- For borrowers, mortgage brokers, and private capital sources
- Contact: 310-686-5053 · Los Angeles area
- Business-purpose lending only. This is not an offer to lend or to buy or sell a security; see the legal and regulatory disclosures.

## Who it's for
- [For borrowers](https://cadeed.com/for-borrowers): Fast, trust-deed-secured financing for a project.
- [For brokers](https://cadeed.com/for-brokers): Place business-purpose loans and keep your client.
- [For capital sources](https://cadeed.com/for-capital-sources): Set your box and receive matching deal flow.
- [Solutions](https://cadeed.com/solutions): Loan types and how routing works.

## Loan types
- Fix & flip / bridge
- Construction completion
- Cash-out and refinance
- Second deeds of trust

## Tools
- [Max loan](https://cadeed.com/tools/max-loan): Estimate the maximum loan for a deal.
- [LTV / LTC](https://cadeed.com/tools/ltv-ltc): Loan-to-value and loan-to-cost.
- [CLTV](https://cadeed.com/tools/cltv): Combined loan-to-value across liens.
- [DSCR](https://cadeed.com/tools/dscr): Debt-service coverage for income property.
- [Flip profit](https://cadeed.com/tools/flip-profit): Estimate profit on a fix-and-flip.
